name: rc-zip
reason: The crate documents low-level ZIP parsers and state machines. A direct public byte-input adapter independent of rc-zip-sync has not yet been run; the verified rc-zip-sync path already records this underlying family.

name: rc-zip-tokio
reason: The Tokio wrapper over rc-zip has a plausible local stream reader, but a pinned control run has not yet been recorded.

name: zipcore
reason: The documented Archive::open(path).by_name API appears eligible. Version 0.10.2 requires crc32fast at least 1.5.2, while the pinned openpack 0.2.7 in this adapter locks crc32fast to 1.5.0; Cargo cannot combine them in one graph. An isolated adapter has not yet been run.

name: libarchive_oxide
reason: Documentation lists a pure-Rust ZIP-capable archive reader, but its local input and entry API have not yet been adapted to the valid control.

name: libarchive
reason: This separate Rust binding to native libarchive has not had a pinned release, documented input call, and valid-control result recorded. It may share the libarchive family with libarchive2.

name: zipsign-api
reason: Registry description says it signs and verifies ZIP files. Whether a public API interprets ZIP entries from local bytes or merely handles whole-file signatures remains unverified.

name: self_update
reason: The registry search returned this updater, which may unpack ZIP releases. A documented public local ZIP input API and control result have not been identified.

name: ripunzip
reason: The registry describes a parallel unzip tool. A version-pinned local-input CLI adapter with observable entry output has not been run.

name: decompress
reason: The registry describes archive extraction, but a documented ZIP-specific local input API and control result remain unverified.

name: betteroffice-opc
reason: The crate describes an OOXML OPC ZIP container reader. Its ability to parse the generic ZIP control through a documented public API has not been checked.
